scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node esbuild.config.mts && pnpm run build:deps && node scripts/copy-og-fonts.mts && cd dist && zip -qr function.zip .
scripts.build:deps: SHARP_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').dependencies.sharp.replace(/^[\^~]/, '')") && mkdir -p dist && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({name:'image-resize-deps',private:true,version:'0.0.0'}))" && cd dist && npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --os=linux --cpu=arm64 --libc=glibc sharp@$SHARP_VERSION
